preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases, with 1 ≤ T ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1])
preconditions.description: Each of the T test cases consists of a line with two integers n and k, where n and k are integers.
Each test case line contains exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(int(n) >= 1 and int(n) <= 10**5 and int(k) >= 0 and int(k) <= int(n) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1] for n, k in [line.strip().split()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is a positive integer with 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5, and k is an integer with 0 ≤ k ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == T for stdout in [output] for output in [stdout])
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1' or all(int(x) >= 1 and int(x) <= n and len(set(int(x) for x in line.strip().split())) == n for line in stdout.splitlines() for n, k in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1].strip().split()] for i in range(T))) for stdout in [stdout])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' or a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1' or sum(1 for i in range(1, n+1) if int(line.strip().split()[i-1]) == i) == k) for line in stdout.splitlines() for n, k in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1].strip().split()] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', it is a permutation of 1..n with exactly k indices i where A_i = i.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1' or (k <= n - k)) for line in stdout.splitlines() for n, k in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1].strip().split()] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: If a permutation exists, it is only possible when k ≤ n - k (i.e., k ≤ n/2). Otherwise, the output is '-1'.
